decision: reject R36 under the original mandatory normal-lifecycle gates

adoption_requires: normal lifecycle correctness and performance gates
gate_policy.cpu_gate_scope: Controller utime+stime from complete phase brackets. B total must not exceed A total plus one raw clock tick per included phase/round. This is a declared resolution tolerance, not a performance improvement claim.
gate_policy.rss_scope: Largest sampled controller RSS across all three controller generations of both rounds per arm; must meet both absolute and ratio gates.
gate_policy.sample_scope: One finite ABBA; each arm has 60 aggregate operation calls and 12 launch/12 live-cancel calls. C6 descriptive comparison, not a saturation or significance claim.
gate_policy.throughput_scope: Successful native RPC count divided by sum of per-phase complete RPC spans; prepare, independent SSH inspection, crash and observation-only phases excluded.

independent_controller_cleanup: unknown; stage-group absence is insufficient and no workload is retried
interpretation: The failed required gate set has four members: aggregate throughput, plus launch throughput, p95 and controller CPU.

At 100 Hz, launch controller CPU implies A=4+5=9 ticks, B=7+5=12 ticks. The original two-tick tolerance yields an 11-tick ceiling, exceeded by one tick. This is not a floating-point near-boundary ambiguity.
Live cancellation and RSS gates pass; they do not override failure of other mandatory gates.
Descriptive summary verified=true means completed coherent evidence, not candidate performance acceptance. Both inner and outer control reports preserve the failed result.
One finite ABBA supports this predeclared acceptance decision, not statistical significance or a proven causal explanation for the regression.
Per parent decision, no async supplement or saturation workload follows this rejected normal-lifecycle result; no replay is used to seek a passing outcome.
limitations: This review uses five downloaded JSON receipts plus frozen local policy/source. It independently recomputes extracted-cell arithmetic and all required gate decisions, but not the original raw RPC timestamps, /proc counters or wire/result data.

The 44 original phase files, four per-round raw reports, four original independent audits and resource traces are referenced by hash but not locally supplied for this review. The later evidence archive can support their raw re-verification.
Controller generation identities, no-retry and source immutability are checked for report consistency, not observed anew on the hosts.
Outer independent-controller cleanup remains unknown in the retained failure report; stage-group absence does not independently prove those controller sessions absent.
Compiler ledger and compiler audit bodies were not rerun locally. Their reported verdict, identity, source pins, policy and guard interval were checked.
Counts describe C6 native lifecycle RPCs, not job-compute throughput, maximum capacity, saturated cancellation or cluster CPU/RSS.

method.controller_cpu: Sum extracted complete-phase utime+stime deltas; cross-check phase summary; raw /proc strings not supplied
method.cpu_gate: B <= A + sum(1/HZ for each B cell) + 1e-12; 100 Hz, 0.10 s aggregate or 0.02 s per phase
method.numeric_consistency_tolerance: math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12,abs_tol=1e-9); original strict gate comparisons retained
method.p95: Nearest rank ceil(0.95*N); all_operations N=60 rank=57, each phase N=12 rank=12, recomputed from the 120 cell latencies
method.rpc_rate: successful native RPC count / sum complete per-phase RPC spans
method.rpc_span: Already-extracted cell span; original per-call clock endpoints not supplied
method.rss: Maximum of all six controller-generation peaks per arm; B <= min(A+512 KiB, A*1.05)
method.waited_child_cpu: Retained separately and excluded from CPU gate
method.whole_phase_means: Recomputed as descriptive values; never substituted for gate RPC-span denominators

outer_failure.reason: normal-lifecycle-abba returned nonzero; original output retained

secondary_reviewer.scope: Independent extracted-cell/summary arithmetic, unchanged required failure outcome; no raw trace re-audit
